Express $\overrightarrow{ZO}$ in terms of $h$ and $d$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$$
\overrightarrow{OG}=h\qquad \overrightarrow{ON}=d .
$$

Trace the path from $G$ through $O$ to $N$:

$$
\overrightarrow{GN}=\overrightarrow{GO}+\overrightarrow{ON}=-h+d.
$$

The ratio $GZ:ZN=4:5$ gives $9$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{GZ}=\frac{4}{9}\overrightarrow{GN}=\frac{4}{9}(-h+d).
$$

Add along the path $O\to G\to Z$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OZ}&=\overrightarrow{OG}+\overrightarrow{GZ}\\&=h+\frac{4}{9}(-h+d)\\&=\frac{5}{9}h+\frac{4}{9}d.\end{aligned}
$$

The requested vector has the reverse direction, so negate both coefficients:

$$
\overrightarrow{ZO}=-\overrightarrow{OZ}=-\frac{5}{9}h-\frac{4}{9}d.

In the diagram, $S$ lies on the segment $ZF$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{ZO}=e$ and $\overrightarrow{FO}=d$. The lengths satisfy $ZS:SF=5:1$.

Express $\overrightarrow{SO}$ in terms of $e$ and $d$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{SO}=$ {{field-1}} $e+$ {{field-2}} $d$"] ["aea2c106-1d81-5af3-a66d-4867b94ad081" :question/worked-solution "First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OZ}=-e\qquad \overrightarrow{OF}=-d .
$$

Trace the path from $Z$ through $O$ to $F$:

$$
\overrightarrow{ZF}=\overrightarrow{ZO}+\overrightarrow{OF}=e-d.
$$

The ratio $ZS:SF=5:1$ gives $6$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{ZS}=\frac{5}{6}\overrightarrow{ZF}=\frac{5}{6}(e-d).
$$

Add along the path $O\to Z\to S$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OS}&=\overrightarrow{OZ}+\overrightarrow{ZS}\\&=-e+\frac{5}{6}(e-d)\\&=-\frac{1}{6}e-\frac{5}{6}d.\end{aligned}
$$

The requested vector has the reverse direction, so negate both coefficients:

$$
\overrightarrow{SO}=-\overrightarrow{OS}=\frac{1}{6}e+\frac{5}{6}d.
$$"] ["aea2c106-1d81-5af3-a66d-4867b94ad081" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["aea2c106-1d81-5af3-a66d-4867b94ad081" :question/answer-fields "9fb2f619-4b48-5816-9626-e873dae993c8"] ["aea2c106-1d81-5af3-a66d-4867b94ad081" :question/answer-fields "db4ba39a-22f4-585c-a808-47d7effb8ee9"] [17592186096653 :knowledge-point/questions "aea2c106-1d81-5af3-a66d-4867b94ad081"]] "retractions" []}
